title: Little things about me
intro: I'm a Software Engineer who enjoys turning ideas into meaningful digital experiences.
description: I am interested in how technology, design, and development processes converge to create functional and meaningful digital products. I am experienced in end-to-end application development from requirements analysis and system architecture design to building web applications as a Full-Stack Developer. On the design front, I enjoy translating user and business needs into intuitive interfaces using UI/UX principles. I have a keen interest in Systems Analysis & Design, specifically in creating systems that are structured, scalable, and maintainable.
